drafts.text:
A guy in my replies called it what it is. Addictive.
I told him back the plan I keep skipping: get paid, stop buying.
The buying is the addiction. Not the losing. The buying.
I know this now. Doesn't mean I stop tonight.
drafts.source: Jesus's own real reply (71 likes) to @NordicTrades's "it's addictive" (104 likes) on the 6 sep receipts post
drafts.why: The single richest real quote available right now, more likes on Jesus's own reply than most full posts get. Naming the addiction directly, not just the symptom.
drafts.why_es: La cita real más rica disponible ahora mismo, más likes en la respuesta del propio Jesus que los que consiguen la mayoría de los posts completos. Nombra la adicción directamente, no solo el síntoma.

drafts.text:
Revenge trading is holding a bad position to prove a point.
Revenge buying is opening a new account to avoid sitting with the last one.
Same habit. Different button.
drafts.source: Jesus's own real reply (10 likes) to @cryptokrazee's "revenge trading" comment, coining "revenge buying" directly
drafts.why: Jesus's own coined term, ties directly to the still-open backlog idea about revenge-buying a new account same day. Aphorism form keeps it citable and rotates the format.
drafts.why_es: Término acuñado por el propio Jesus, conecta directo con la idea aún abierta en el backlog sobre recomprar una cuenta el mismo día. La forma de aforismo lo mantiene citable y rota el formato.

drafts.text:
Someone told me the spending isn't really the problem. It's just the surface. The real thing underneath is how I'm wired to react.
Didn't want that to be true. A budget is a lot easier to fix than an identity.
Starting with the budget anyway. Has to start somewhere.
drafts.source: @apodochiHQ's "identity wired a certain way" comment (41 likes) + @Mateo Rivera's monthly-budget tip (14 likes), both on the 6 sep receipts post
drafts.why: Combines the deeper psychological reframe with a concrete, actionable fix in one honest post. Rotates format toward reflective truth-bomb.
drafts.why_es: Combina el replanteamiento psicológico más profundo con un arreglo concreto y accionable en un solo post honesto. Rota el formato hacia el truth-bomb reflexivo.
